integrity: Research includes analytical proofs and a separately executable standard-library verification script; no independent audit or certification performed.
limitations: One rank-one LU step, real nonsingular 2x2 inputs, Gaussian sketch, exact arithmetic; no multistep, high-dimensional or finite-precision conclusions. Sketch width b<=2 obstruction uses ill-conditioned diagonal inputs, high-moment obstruction uses uniformly conditioned SPD inputs. General upper constants not claimed optimal.
title: A sharp Gaussian-sketch width threshold for the mean-square stability of randomized LU pivots
